def cache_sim(capacity, ttl, ops):
    from collections import OrderedDict
    
    cache = OrderedDict()
    expiry_times = {}
    results = []
    
    for op in ops:
        if op[0] == 'put':
            _, t, key, value = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, exp_t in expiry_times.items() if exp_t <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del expiry_times[k]
            
            # If key already exists, remove it (will be re-added at end)
            if key in cache:
                del cache[key]
            # If cache is at capacity and key is new, evict LRU
            elif len(cache) >= capacity:
                lru_key = next(iter(cache))
                del cache[lru_key]
                del expiry_times[lru_key]
            
            # Add the new entry
            cache[key] = value
            expiry_times[key] = t + ttl
        
        elif op[0] == 'get':
            _, t, key = op
            
            # Remove expired entries
            expired_keys = [k for k, exp_t in expiry_times.items() if exp_t <= t]
            for k in expired_keys:
                del cache[k]
                del expiry_times[k]
            
            # Try to get the key
            if key in cache:
                results.append(cache[key])
                # Move to end (most recently used)
                cache.move_to_end(key)
            else:
                results.append(-1)
    
    return results
